messages:
ameera: Customer reported SSO failures right after we rotated the IdP signing cert and introduced an HTTP rewrite proxy in front of the ACS endpoint. Error from SP logs: `SignatureValidationFailed`.

josh: Can you paste the exact IdP metadata the customer uploaded? sometimes cert ordering or a whitespace issue breaks xml parsing.

ameera: Pasted below (redacted). They said they uploaded new metadata at 14:05 UTC. ACS is behind a rewrite that strips query params and forces a trailing slash.

<marta uploaded metadata>: ```<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.examplecorp.com">
  <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
    <KeyInfo>...CERT A...</KeyInfo>
  </KeyDescriptor>
  <KeyDescriptor use="signing">
    <KeyInfo>...CERT B...</KeyInfo>
  </KeyDescriptor>
  <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.customer.com/saml/acs" index="0"/>
</EntityDescriptor>```

josh: Hmm. Two signing keys — we prefer the first one, but our Metadata fetcher sometimes picks the wrong KeyDescriptor when XML has no `ds:KeyInfo` namespace or order is unexpected. Also the rewrite proxy forcing trailing slash means the `Location` they uploaded doesn't match our SP's ACS (we strip trailing slash).

ameera: Customer timeline: rotated cert -> re-uploaded metadata -> started getting 401s at 14:20 -> they tried to hit ACS manually and got 400 from proxy -> our support repro showed `SAMLResponse` signature mismatch.

eng-oncall: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm SP ACS URL canonicalization. 2) Verify which IdP cert our service used to validate signature at time of failure. 3) Check if proxy rewrote the POST body (rare but happens with some proxies). 4) Confirm metadata parser picks the correct KeyDescriptor when multiple signing keys are present.

josh: I pulled the validation logs: ``[2026-02-12T14:21:03Z] validate_signature: cert_thumb=SHA1:AB:CD:... used_cert_index=1 result=failed
[2026-02-12T14:21:03Z] available_certs=[index0:SHA1:12:34..., index1:SHA1:AB:CD...]``

marta: I also found a proxy log showing body altered: ``POST /saml/acs/ 200 - content-length reduced`` — looks like proxy removed an empty param in form data which changed canonicalization.

ameera: Customer says the cert they rotated (now primary) corresponds to index0. We used index1 during validation. Looks like our metadata fetcher cache still had old ordering or our fallback picked the second key.

eng-oncall: Mitigation steps for customer: 1) Ask IdP to temporarily include only the current signing key in metadata (single KeyDescriptor) OR 2) Configure the proxy to passthrough POST bodies unchanged and not alter trailing slash -> quick fix.

josh: For our side: create a fix ticket to update metadata parser to prefer KeyDescriptor with Matching KeyInfo that matches Signature KeyInfo in the SAMLResponse (if present), and log exact chosen key thumbprint. Also add a non-breaking config to normalize ACS URL on ingest (strip/append trailing slash consistently).

marta: Repro steps I used: 1) Upload metadata with two signing keys (as above). 2) Send signed SAMLResponse signed with index0 key but with ACS rewritten to add trailing slash. 3) Observe `SignatureValidationFailed` in SP logs and proxy body length mismatch.

ameera: Customer agreed to flip proxy to passthrough and re-upload metadata with single key for now. They've accepted the workaround.

eng-oncall: I'll open ENG ticket: ENG-14672 (internal) — include logs, metadata xml, proxy config snippet, and recommended mitigations. Suggested priority P1 for SSO regressions affecting production auth.

josh: Add this to runbook: when cert rotation + proxy present -> check (a) metadata key order, (b) proxy body rewrite rules, (c) exact ACS URL canonicalization.

support-bot: Incident note created: #INC-2026-3246 attached to thread 2169999876.

ameera: Closing loop — customer confirmed SSO working after proxy change and metadata replace at 15:03 UTC. Will follow up with permanent fix timeline. :white_check_mark:
